messages:
emma (docs): Heads-up: big docs refactor touching /migration and /examples. Previews showing broken anchors and example links. PRs: #4301 (move migration), #4306 (examples rename + redirects), #4309 (snippet updates). Preview failing: https://deploy-preview-4301--redwood-docs.netlify.app/migration.html#step-4

dan (eng): Seen it. The usual race: file move before redirect -> anchor missing. We should land a tiny redirect first.

noah (platform): I can open a 1-line redirect PR and set the link-checker to warn-only for a 30m window. That avoids noisy failures in deploy previews.

pr-bot: [ci] deploy-preview-4301 failed: 1 broken link -> /migration.html#step-4

emma (docs): Proposed order: 1) #4312 redirect PR -> merge 2) merge #4301 (move) 3) merge #4306 (cleanup/redirect removal) 4) merge #4309 (snippets). Requesting review from @dan and @olivia. Target window: today 15:30-16:30 PT.

olivia (docs): I'll take #4309 (snippets). I'll add backwards-compatible examples for renamed helpers to reduce user impact.

dan (eng): I'll review #4301 once redirect is merged. Local repro: `yarn docs:build && ./bin/link-checker` -> error: "Missing anchor 'step-4' in migration.md"

noah (platform): Redirect PR #4312 opened (WIP). Also will prepare a quick CDN purge command if old path persists after merge.

emma (docs): Adding `docs/merge-window` label and update PR descriptions with exact merge order and rollback steps. After each merge run `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url <deploy-preview>` and confirm anchors. If preview still errors, revert the last merge and purge cache.

dan (eng): Sounds good. I'll be on standby at 15:25 PT to approve. :thumbsup:
